name: text-extractor
description: Lightweight MCP server for extracting text from PDFs and images with quality-aware fallback routing.

tools.name: extract_text_from_file
tools.description: Extract text from a PDF or image file as markdown.

tools.name: extract_text_pages
tools.description: Extract text from specific pages of a PDF.

tools.name: get_document_info
tools.description: Get document metadata and structure before extraction.

notes: Optional extras: text-extractor[ocr] for OCR stack, text-extractor[docling] for complex layout extraction.
